summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes standard quarterly disclosures: segment revenue, fair value hierarchy details, share-based compensation, foreign exchange hedging instruments, and a Sun Corporation acquiree component. No strategic corporate event is described — no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or capital return. The only forward-looking date is a contractual earn-out or tranche condition on March 1, 2027, tied to a prior SCG Canada Inc. acquisition. This is a routine interim reporting obligation, not a special situation.
